budget_items.what_was_said: The committee spent part of the grant money in the annual report year; a building operation certificate training for the school was missed because no one was in place.
Projects included appliances, lighting, refrigerators, hot water replacement, hybrid police vehicles and public safety building fixes, with projected annual savings stated.
The three PV systems cost a stated amount to install and save a stated amount per year, generating some kilowatt hours.
Total energy usage is down against the baseline over three years, though water and sewer costs rose.
Deliverables include cost savings analysis and incentives for a grant application, procurement assistance, and installation management; the RFP says no reimbursable expenses and no advance payment.
Unclear whether the town can pay the designer first and be reimbursed under one grant later; the Green Communities contact will be asked.
Adding fixtures reduces overall savings; any added lights might be funded from facilities money encumbered at year end.

what_happened.line: The task force spent most of the meeting reviewing a draft LED street light designer RFP adapted from another town's.
Members agreed the RFP's scope stays at replacing existing street lights with efficient ones, not adding new lighting.
The chair will ask the Green Communities contact whether grant money can reimburse designer costs the town pays first.
Members will send RFP comments only to the chair, because of open meeting law; the chair will update the light table and send the RFP for review.
The task force heard the annual Green Communities report, which showed total energy use down against the baseline while water and sewer costs rose.

why_it_matters: The RFP decides what the town asks a designer to do on street lights, which sets how much of the savings from LED replacement the town keeps and how the work may be paid for.
Whether grant money can reimburse a designer the town pays first is unsettled, so the town may have to cover that cost up front before a grant offsets it.
